proposal.summary: Adobe After Effects <= 22.0 and <= 18.4.2 have an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could disclose sensitive memory and bypass mitigations such as ASLR; exploitation requires the victim to open a malicious file.
proposal.affected_product: Adobe After Effects versions 22.0 (and earlier) and 18.4.2 (and earlier)
proposal.cwe_quote: are affected by an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

AV.quote: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass mitigations such as ASLR.

UI.quote: Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file.

C.quote: could lead to disclosure of sensitive memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request proof-of-concept or crash trace and confirm whether data read can be exfiltrated; determine exact triggering file format and provide reproduction steps and fixed versions from vendor.
